name: Hockey – Cold Rink, Hot Takes
title: Hockey – Cold Rink, Hot Takes Ornament
story: This hockey ornament is for the hockey parent or fan with an opinion on every call: a thermos, a plaid blanket and a pair of skates on a frosty bench, and an easy stocking gift for the rink regular.

The print is a steaming thermos and a rolled plaid blanket on an icy rink bench, with a pair of skates hanging off the end, under COLD RINK, HOT TAKES. in heavy slab capitals in cream and red on a navy disc. The art matches our Cold Rink, Hot Takes crewneck, so the ornament makes a set with the sweatshirt.

Anyone who has sat in a freezing rink at 6 a.m. knows the routine: coffee in the thermos, a blanket on the bench and a loud opinion about the referee. The ornament says it in four words. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the hockey parent who has earned it. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: Rinks are cold and hockey parents are not, which is the whole joke. The Cold Rink, Hot Takes ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a steaming thermos, a plaid blanket and a pair of skates on a rink bench, so anyone who has sat in the stands gets it at a glance.
